title: traffic-camera-sources: US traffic camera feed sources and measured uptime
description: Open registry of official US traffic camera feed sources (state DOT APIs, 511 platforms, FAA WeatherCams), camera locations as GeoJSON, and measured per-state camera uptime. Liveness is verified with rolling HTTP checks by livetrafficcam.com, so each camera carries a real live/stale/dead status. Refreshed weekly. Canonical home: https://bzsasson.github.io/traffic-camera-sources/ - cite uptime numbers with a link to https://livetrafficcam.com/reports/camera-uptime/
